reason: The problem on the cover is a Nairobi shop getting fake M-Pesa texts, and that is not my problem. Pretty slides about a till I don't have, from a design studio talking to other designers, don't get me to pay anything this year.
objection: I can't see what this does for my business in particular. It reads like something built for a shop in Kenya, and I'd have to work out whether any of it fits my own takings before I could trust it.
would_change_my_mind: A short example using the card or booking system I already run, showing the exact money it would have caught last month, with a clear price I could cancel in a month.
